entities.title: No two players on one device
entities.summary: Two people play each other only online, each on their own device; the page has no way to start a two-player game.
entities.impact: A friend in the same room needs a second device.

entities.title: Online games can't be paused
entities.summary: Pause presses never travel online, and hiding the tab does not pause an online game.
entities.impact: A player who looks away keeps the game going; a hidden tab makes the other player wait.

entities.title: Two players online
entities.summary: An online game takes the two lowest slots in the room; a third browser in the match is left out of the start and keeps waiting.
entities.impact: A lobby game of three or more plays as two, and the others do not play.

entities.title: Games without a server seed can't be entered
entities.summary: A game that started before a seed arrived from the server still plays, but no name is asked for at the end, and the page does not say why.
entities.impact: A player whose connection drops, or who starts at once on a slow one, loses the chance to enter that game.
entities.workaround: Wait a moment on the title screen before pressing 1.

entities.title: Two-hour replays
entities.summary: The server replays games of up to two hours, and seeds expire after 24 hours unused.
entities.impact: A longer game, or one submitted a day later, is refused.

entities.title: A tie with the tenth row isn't enough
entities.summary: The page offers the table only to a score that beats the tenth row of a full table.
entities.impact: A player who equals the tenth score is not asked for a name.

entities.title: Plain names
entities.summary: Names are up to 12 plain characters; accents are dropped and a few letters spelled out (Þór becomes Thor).
entities.impact: Names in other scripts cannot be shown.
